correctness.rationale: For all unrooted fully resolved trees with the seven named leaves, edge subdivision from the three-leaf star has a unique deletion inverse and gives 3·5·7·9=945 topologies. Exactly 105 Boolean quartet predicates are indexed. The certificate provides six queries (0,21,42,54,76,82) with all 64 distinct patterns; I inspected its 64 tree-witness indices and the 511 internal query indices/512 leaf witnesses for a nine-level adaptive tree. I independently constructed all 945 rooted six-leaf hierarchies with the seventh leaf attached, derived quartet predicates from four-point distances, obtained exactly 206992 search nodes and no shattered seven-query set containing index zero, and established symmetry reduction by S7 transitivity. Independent dynamic shattering recursion confirmed depth nine; depth ten is impossible since 1024>945. This is a complete finite proof for precisely seven leaves, not a claim for unbounded taxa.
